articleContent.en: Our school decided to host an international culture day this Saturday.
articleContent.zh: 我們學校決定在這個週六主辦一場國際文化日。

articleContent.en: Mr. Lin asked Leo to pick up some snacks for the special custom display.
articleContent.zh: 林老師請里歐去買一些特色習俗展覽要用的小吃。

articleContent.en: Leo went to the supermarket and found a ten percent discount on fruit cakes.
articleContent.zh: 里歐去了超級市場，發現水果蛋糕有打九折的折扣。

articleContent.en: However, the popular strawberry cookies were completely sold out.
articleContent.zh: 然而，熱門的草莓餅乾已經完全賣完了。

articleContent.en: The cashier told Leo that there would be an extra charge for gift boxes.
articleContent.zh: 收銀員告訴里歐，禮品盒需要額外收費。

articleContent.en: Leo bought the cakes and returned to the classroom happily.
articleContent.zh: 里歐買了蛋糕並高興地回到教室。

articleContent.en: Many students decided to take part in the school garden cleanup on Sunday morning.
articleContent.zh: 許多學生決定在週日早上參加學校花園的大掃除。

articleContent.en: They worked hard to get rid of thick weeds near the big tree.
articleContent.zh: 他們努力拔除大樹附近濃密的雜草。

articleContent.en: Ken saw a giant tree root growing under the old wooden bench.
articleContent.zh: 肯恩看到一條巨大的樹根生長在舊木椅下方。

articleContent.en: Suddenly, a worker noticed a red mark on the damaged roof of the garden shed.
articleContent.zh: 突然間，一名工人注意到花園棚屋損壞的屋頂上有個紅色記號。

articleContent.en: The worker fixed the roof quickly so there was no error in the safety report.
articleContent.zh: 工人迅速修好了屋頂，因此安全報告中沒有任何錯誤。

articleContent.en: All the volunteers felt proud after finishing the difficult task.
articleContent.zh: 所有志工在完成這項艱鉅的任務後都感到很自豪。

What did the students try to get rid of near the tree?
When did the garden cleanup take place?
Where was the giant tree root growing?

Why did the worker fix the roof quickly?
options: To avoid errors in the safety report
questions.correct: To avoid errors in the safety report

articleContent.en: Uncle David drove his car to the city stadium yesterday afternoon.
articleContent.zh: 大衛叔叔昨天下午開車去市立體育館。

articleContent.en: He parked in a no-parking zone by error because the sign was hidden.
articleContent.zh: 因為標誌被遮住了，他失誤將車停在禁停區。

articleContent.en: A police officer had to tow the car away to the parking yard.
articleContent.zh: 一名警官不得不把車子拖吊到保管場。

articleContent.en: The officer explained the link between illegal parking and heavy traffic jams.
articleContent.zh: 警官解釋了違規停車與嚴重交通堵塞之間的關聯。

articleContent.en: Uncle David had to pay a service charge and an extra fine to get his car back.
articleContent.zh: 大衛叔叔必須支付一筆服務費和額外罰款才能領回他的車。

articleContent.en: He promised to follow all the traffic rules carefully in the future.
articleContent.zh: 他保證未來一定會仔細遵守所有交通規則。

questions.question: Who drove to the city stadium yesterday afternoon?
What happened to Uncle David's car?
options: It was towed away by a police officer
It broke down on the road
It was sold to another person
questions.correct: It was towed away by a police officer

questions.question: When did Uncle David go to the stadium?

options: The link between illegal parking and traffic jams

The link between car weight and road damage
questions.correct: The link between illegal parking and traffic jams

questions.question: Why did Uncle David have to pay an extra fine?
options: To get his car back from the parking yard
To buy a new stadium ticket
questions.correct: To get his car back from the parking yard

readingStage3Data.title: Hansel and Gretel in the Forest (糖果屋歷險)

articleContent.en: Hansel and Gretel were left in the deep forest by their parents.
articleContent.zh: 韓賽爾與葛麗特被父母留在了深林之中。

articleContent.en: Hansel dropped some pieces of bread to leave a mark on the path so they could find their way home.
articleContent.zh: 韓賽爾丟下麵包碎屑在小徑上留下記號，以便他們能找到回家的路。

articleContent.en: Later, the hungry children tripped over a large tree root while walking in the dark woods.
articleContent.zh: 後來，飢餓的孩子們在黑暗的樹林中行走時被一條大樹根絆倒了。

articleContent.en: Suddenly, they saw a wonderful house with sweet cookies on its roof.
articleContent.zh: 突然間，他們看到了一座屋頂上鋪著香甜餅乾的奇妙房子。

articleContent.en: A wicked old witch lived inside the house and tried to trap the little children.
articleContent.zh: 一個邪惡的老巫婆住在房子裡，企圖困住這兩個年幼的孩子。

articleContent.en: Gretel bravely pushed the witch into the oven and saved her brother.
articleContent.zh: 葛麗特勇敢地把巫婆推進烤箱，救了她的哥哥。

What did the children see on the roof of the strange house?
When did the children trip over the tree root?
options: While walking in the dark woods
After they returned to their house
questions.correct: While walking in the dark woods

questions.question: Where did the wicked old witch live?
options: High up in a wooden tower

questions.question: Why did Hansel leave marks along the path?
options: To find their way back home
questions.correct: To find their way back home

questions.question: How did Gretel save her brother from danger?
options: By pushing the witch into the oven
By asking forest animals for help
By running away alone into the dark
questions.correct: By pushing the witch into the oven

readingStage3Data.title: Cinderella and the Royal Ball (仙度瑞拉的舞會)

articleContent.en: The royal palace announced that the prince would host a grand ball for all the ladies.
articleContent.zh: 王宮宣布王子將為所有女士主辦一場盛大的舞會。

articleContent.en: Cinderella really wanted to take part in the celebration, but her cruel stepmother gave her endless chores.
articleContent.zh: 仙度瑞拉非常想參加這場慶祝活動，但她殘忍的繼母給了她做不完的家務。

articleContent.en: According to royal custom, every guest had to arrive before the palace gates closed at midnight.
articleContent.zh: 按照王室習俗，每位賓客都必須在午夜王宮大門關閉前抵達。

articleContent.en: A kind fairy godmother appeared and magically transformed a pumpkin into a golden carriage.
articleContent.zh: 一位善良的神仙教母出現了，並用魔法將一顆南瓜變成了金色馬車。

articleContent.en: Cinderella wore a beautiful gown with glowing glass slippers and danced with the prince.
articleContent.zh: 仙度瑞拉穿著美麗的禮服和閃亮的玻璃鞋，與王子共舞。

articleContent.en: She quickly ran away before the clock struck twelve, leaving behind one shiny glass slipper.
articleContent.zh: 她在鐘聲敲響十二點前迅速逃走，留下了一隻閃亮的玻璃鞋。

questions.question: Who hosted the grand ball at the royal palace?
What did the fairy godmother turn into a golden carriage?
When did the guests have to arrive at the royal palace?
Where did Cinderella dance with the prince?
Why was Cinderella unable to go to the ball at first?
options: Because her stepmother gave her endless chores
Because she lost her party invitation
Because she woke up too late
questions.correct: Because her stepmother gave her endless chores

questions.question: What did Cinderella leave behind when she ran away?

readingStage3Data.title: Tom Sawyer Paints the Fence (湯姆歷險記：刷籬笆)

articleContent.en: On a sunny Saturday, Aunt Polly told Tom to paint the long wooden fence.
articleContent.zh: 在一個陽光明媚的星期六，波莉阿姨叫湯姆去刷長長的木籬笆。

articleContent.en: Tom wanted to get rid of this boring chore, so he came up with a clever plan.
articleContent.zh: 湯姆想擺脫這個無聊的苦差事，於是想出了一個聰明的計畫。

articleContent.en: When his friend Ben walked by, Tom pretended that painting was an exciting art that required an extra payment to try.
articleContent.zh: 當他的朋友班走過時，湯姆假裝刷油漆是一門刺激的藝術，需要額外付費才能嘗試。

articleContent.en: Ben begged for a chance, so Tom decided not to charge any money but took Ben's red apple instead.
articleContent.zh: 班懇求給他一次機會，所以湯姆決定不收取任何金錢，而是拿走了班的紅蘋果。

articleContent.en: Soon, other boys gave Tom their favorite toys just to pick up the paintbrush and paint a section.
articleContent.zh: 不久，其他男孩給了湯姆他們最喜歡的玩具，只為了拿起油漆刷去刷上一段。

articleContent.en: By the afternoon, the fence had three coats of paint, and Tom became the richest boy in town.
articleContent.zh: 到下午時，籬笆已經刷了三層油漆，而湯姆成了鎮上最富有的男孩。

questions.question: Who told Tom Sawyer to paint the long fence?
What did Ben give Tom to get a turn to paint?
When did Aunt Polly ask Tom to do the chore?
Where did the boys gather to paint the fence?
options: In front of Aunt Polly's house
questions.correct: In front of Aunt Polly's house

questions.question: Why did the other boys want to paint the fence?
options: Because Tom pretended it was a special and fun art
Because Aunt Polly promised them money
Because they wanted to help the community
questions.correct: Because Tom pretended it was a special and fun art

questions.question: How many coats of paint did the fence receive by the afternoon?
